g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Firms with 10 or more employees, all industries, latest year (2023 or later). Correlation with GDP per capita: r = 0.47. GDP per capita is economic output per person (adjusted for price differences between countries), not household income. Luxembourg's and Ireland's GDP is inflated by cross-border workers and multinational profits.'

text.tspan: Firms with 10 or more employees, all industries, latest year (2023 or later). Correlation with GDP per capita: r = 0.47.
GDP per capita is economic output per person (adjusted for price differences between countries), not household income.
Luxembourg's and Ireland's GDP is inflated by cross-border workers and multinational profits.
